newsitem.title: USA: First Merchants faces class-action suit.
newsitem.headline: First Merchants faces class-action suit.

text.p: The law firms of Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP and Miller Faucher Chertow Cafferty and Wexler said on Friday they filed notice of pendency of a class-action lawsuit, alleging that First Merchants Acceptance Corp violated securities laws.
The suit claims that First Merchants issued a series of false and misleading finacial statements and news releases that artificially inflated the value of its stock.
First Merchant officials were not immediately available for comment.
Earlier this week, First Merchants said it would restate its 1996 results after finding "irregularities involving unauthorized entries" in its records.
First Merchants stock fell to $3.25 per share from $7.625 after the announcement, the law firms said.
On Friday, the stock was off 1/8, to 3-1/8. Its 52-week high was 27.
The class action suit was filed on behalf of people who bought stock between April 18, 1996 and April 16, 1997.
First Merchants finances the purchase of used cars by consumers with limited access to traditional credit sources.
